name: web-cobalt-about-slide-with-brand-pills-and-gantt-timeline
title: Cobalt About Slide and Gantt Project Line
whatItIs: Two stacked panels on navy: a cobalt panel with a huge light 'About' and a description, next to tilted client-logo pills; and a white 'Project Line' Gantt chart with coloured bars for research, strategy, UX design and UI design across four weeks.
whatItMeans: Tilted logo pills add energy and social proof, and the coloured Gantt makes the schedule instantly readable.
techniques: Tilted pills of client logos cropped at the edge
Giant lightweight word as the title
Coloured horizontal bars for phases across a week grid
Panels stacked on a dark base
Blue as the primary, pastels for phases

vocabulary.definition: A rounded label containing a client's logo.
A timeline of horizontal bars showing task durations.
A coloured bar representing one project stage.
